name: Scripted ideal decisions, no model call (offline)
description: Runs the real orchestrator and tool catalogue with a planner that replays each case's ideal decisions, so every change a case requires lands once on the right quest and nothing else is written.
advantages: Free and deterministic; shows that the cases and the scorer separate a right turn from a wrong one, and that the code around the model adds no write of its own.
disadvantages: Says nothing about how a real model decides; declared reach, receipts for claimed acts and people with no external environment are not measured.

name: Rules only, no model (floor)
description: No model and no orchestrator: a request shaped like a goal or a note is written as one, whatever else it asked.
advantages: No cost and instant; marks the least a first draft does.
disadvantages: Writes what was not asked when the shape misleads it, and cannot answer a question about reach.
